plan_document: docs/future_work_A_rolling_rfm.md (v2), sections 4 and 5; P5 (hidden Markov model) is NOT part of this run
nature: exploratory pre-check for future work A (rolling RFM labels); post-hoc relative to D's frozen Test; never replaces any registered result

data.orders: A snapshot 2ae672b7ea6edb7f5e1561b6a64823004dea833e, data/processed/A_data_preparation/orders.csv.gz; rows with invoice_datetime >= 2010-12-01 are dropped immediately after reading and the maximum date is asserted < 2010-12-01 (P0-P3 use no Validation or Test orders)
data.validation_use: P1 flags which Profile customers have eligible Validation baskets (population flag only); P4 evaluates on Validation eligible baskets through the extra_eval engine. Test is never read (engine lock).
data.population: the 2,684 Profile customers of B's frozen K-means labels; customers first seen after 2010-06-01 are only counted (section 6.3 of the plan)

rfm_definition.valid_orders: is_valid_rfm_order == 1 and is_identified_customer == 1 (same filter as src/online_trade/clustering/features.py)
rfm_definition.R: days from the customer's last valid order before the cutoff (any time since 2009-12-01) to the cutoff
rfm_definition.F: distinct valid basket_id in the window (0 if none)
rfm_definition.M: sum of gross_purchase_amount of valid orders in the window (0 if none)
rfm_definition.self_check: at cutoff 2010-06-01 the computed R/F/M must equal build_rfm() for every Profile customer

P0_reconstruction.scaler: StandardScaler fit on the 2,684 Profile customers' features at cutoff 2010-06-01 (deterministic)
P0_reconstruction.centroids: mean standardized feature vector of each frozen cluster
P0_reconstruction.check: nearest-centroid reassignment of the Profile features must reproduce 100% of the frozen labels; otherwise report mismatches and stop

P1_primary.assignment: frozen scaler and centroids from P0, nearest centroid (Euclidean)
outputs: silence rate per old cluster (no valid order in the window)
Cohen's kappa and ARI between old and new labels
share with R above the Profile maximum R
cluster sizes old/new and mean standardized position of each old cluster's members in the new window vs its centroid
populations: Profile customers with at least one eligible Validation basket

P2_sensitivity.P2a_relative: refit StandardScaler on the 2,684 customers' Discovery-window features (silent customers included), assign to the frozen centroids
P2_sensitivity.P2b_refit: fit StandardScaler and KMeans(n_clusters=3, n_init=10, random_state=42) on customers active in the Discovery window; silent customers assigned to the nearest fitted centroid; new clusters aligned to old labels by the Hungarian algorithm on the 3x3 member-overlap matrix (MONIC-style); report the overlap matrix and agreement
P2_sensitivity.P2c_active_only: P1 labels restricted to customers with >= 1 valid order in the Discovery window

P3_drift_curve.labels: each cutoff's 6-month window, frozen scaler and centroids
P3_drift_curve.compare: frozen labels (cutoff 2010-06-01) vs labels at 2010-06-01 + delta, delta = 1..6 months
P3_drift_curve.metrics: retention, chance retention sum_i p_i q_i, Cohen's kappa; all customers and active-in-both-windows customers

P4_impact_bound.rules: P5 Discovery lists, E9 construction (V3 combination de-duplication), budget 100 per customer; budgets 20 and 50 reported descriptively

systems.L_orig: each customer uses the list of their frozen label (must equal E9's L Validation coverage; asserted against results/tables/extra_eval/E9/summary.csv)
systems.L_swap: same three lists, each customer uses the list of their P1 label
systems.L_oracle: each customer uses, after the fact, whichever of the three lists covers most of their own Validation orders (ties: keep the frozen label's list, then lowest group id)
systems.A1: 100 seeds 1000-1099: each seed's three lists, orig assignment and oracle assignment; oracle gain per seed

P4_impact_bound.primary_metric: order coverage on Validation at budget 100; customer-macro coverage reported alongside
P4_impact_bound.intervals: paired customer bootstrap, 2,000 repeats, seed 20261121 (same as extra_eval) for L_swap - L_orig, L_swap_P2a - L_orig, L_oracle - L_orig
P4_impact_bound.adjusted_oracle_gain: (L_oracle - L_orig) minus the A1 median of the same quantity; descriptive

decision_rules.stage1_labels_stable: P1 kappa (all customers) >= 0.6 AND P2c retention >= 0.80 -> 'labels essentially stable'; plan section 6 is not run. The same rule applied with P2a kappa is reported as 'stable after season adjustment' (descriptive)
decision_rules.stage2_no_room: raw oracle gain (L_oracle - L_orig, order coverage, B=100) < 1.0 percentage point -> 'label refresh cannot matter for these lists'; section 6 is not run
decision_rules.stage3_go: otherwise, if L_swap - L_orig >= 0.5 percentage point -> run section 6 round 2 (separately registered); else stop
decision_rules.note: all five steps are computed and reported regardless of the stage at which the decision route stops

known_information_before_registration: E9, E10 and E5 Validation results (results/tables/extra_eval/) and D's Validation and Test results had been read.
Chen, Guo & Li (2019) report month-to-month group stability (diagonal sum 0.85) on the one-year Online Retail data.

The A2 random controls (2026-11-15) were stratified by each Profile customer's Discovery eligible-basket count, so the distribution of Discovery basket counts (including customers with zero) had been seen; no Discovery-window RFM, label or transition had been computed.
No P0-P4 quantity had been computed.
